title: 30A Beach House Cozinest at Treetop Panhandle Getaways
meta_description: 30A Beach House pet friendly rental, Cozinest at Treetop, located in Seacrest, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 5 bedroom, 4.5 bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. 4 Bikes Included
description_expanded: Description Description 30A Beach House pet friendly rental, Cozinest at Treetop, located in Seacrest, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 5 bedroom, 4.5 bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. 4 Bikes Included Traveling with a pet? Upon arrival, your pup will receive a Posh Pet Gift Pack filled with fun, beach-ready goodies. Each pack also includes a Posh Pet Photo Contest card with a QR code for easy uploads - simply share a photo of your furry friend enjoying their new gear and bandana. If your pet is featured on our website or social channels, you’ll receive special swag or exclusive discounts. Sunshine, sand, and tail-wagging adventures await! This beautifully appointed home is nestled within the gated Treetop community, just a short walk or bike ride from the world-class beaches, dining, parks, and boutiques of Inlet Beach, Alys Beach, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach. Designed with both comfort and style in mind, this pet-friendly retreat features stunning furnishings, intricate woodwork, shiplap accents, hardwood floors, and quartz countertops throughout. The home offers two main suites, spacious covered decks, and lush landscaping that provides added privacy for guests. Outdoor amenities include a cozy fire pit and a cornhole game, making this a favorite vacation rental for relaxation and fun. Free Activities Included. see details below*** FEATURES* 5 Bedrooms, 4.5 Bathroom* Bedroom 1 - King Bed, Smart TV, En Suite Bath * Bedroom 2 - King Bed, Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom * Bedroom 3 - King Bed, Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom * Bedroom 4 - King Bed, Smart TV* Bathroom 4 - Tub/Shower Combo* Bedroom 5 - 2 Bunk Beds (Full/Full, Full/Full), Smart TV* Living Area - Large Smart TV* Fully Equipped Kitchen with Breakfast Bar* Dining Area * Living Area - Queen Sleeper* Half Bathroom on Main Level* Covered Decks* Outdoor Gas Grill* Backyard Firepit with Seating* Outdoor Shower* Screened in Deck - TV, Games, Seating* Games - Scrabble, Jenga, Card Games* Indoor Gas Fireplace* Cornhole* Use of Owners Beach Chairs and Umbrellas *** 4 Parking Spaces Only - Strictly Enforced* Complimentary High Speed WI-FI* Sleeps 18 **Please note, the owner provides use of their personal beach chairs and umbrella. Should a beach chair or umbrella be broken, missing or similar there will be no refund as the use is provided at the courtesy of the owner. 30A Beach Access Points ABOUT TREETOP VILLAGE IN SEACREST, FL This gated Seacrest community is nestled between Alys and Rosemary Beach offering a prime 30A location. The community includes easy access with 2 private entrances off 30A and Hwy 98. Guests will enjoy being within walking distance to all the shops and restaurants at Seacrest, Alys and Rosemary Beach. COMMUNITY AMENITIESPoolWalk to Restaurants and Shops Bonus***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct) PET FRIENDLY WITH STIPULATIONSWe welcome well-trained dogs to stay in this home. We require that your dog be completely potty trained and prefer dogs older than 2 years old. Crate Trained pups are preferred to deter mischievous behavior while you and your party are enjoying the beach. It is understood that while we do allow dogs with the mentioned stipulations any damages that occur during your stay will be charged to the credit card on file with the minimum fee being $350.00. INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVALPanhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar and body wash. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens & towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach. Read less

Extras, Services & Complimentary Items: 1 Complimentary Round of Golf Each Day (March - Oct)
